1.explanation: This small React app imports the Carbon Checkbox component, enables the new `readOnly` prop, and renders four variants: unchecked, checked, and two grouped items. When you run this (e.g. `yarn start` in a CRA sandbox with Carbon installed) you’ll see exactly the color‐token mismatches and spacing errors depicted in the issue images. This gives you a minimal repro to verify and style-fix the read-only state.
1.bug_scenario:
The bug shows up when you render the new "readOnly" variant of the Carbon Checkbox component. In the mocks you can see:
- Unchecked read-only boxes are using the disabled icon border color ($icon-disabled) instead of the placeholder text color ($text-placeholder).
- Checked read-only boxes are still drawing the primary‐colored checkmark ($icon-primary) and text ($text-primary) instead of using the disabled token.
- When rendered in a fieldset (group) the vertical spacing between each read-only item is off (should be 16px) and the label typography is using the secondary token ($text-secondary) but the boxes themselves aren’t matching the read-only spec spacing or color tokens.

All of these mismatches occur because the new “readOnly” prop has been wired up but the styles haven’t been hooked into the existing Checkbox Sass, so the tokens don’t override correctly.
